en: Black-and-white seaside view of the Mamaia resort on the Black Sea, with modernist beachfront hotels and people on the beach and in shallow water. The image carries the caption 'Vedere din Mamaia'. The reverse side reads 'REPUBLICA POPULARĂ ROMÎNĂ' and 'CARTE POȘTALĂ', with publisher 'Editura Meridiane', price 'Lei 1', number '8160', and a handwritten Romanian message addressed to a family in Bucharest.
